lede: Mississippi State carries the stronger underlying team rating — +1.1 against -2.0, a 3.1-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Minnesota -4.1 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Minnesota winning 61% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is kicking, where Mississippi State leads Minnesota by 62 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 41% — enough to publish, not enough to treat the exact margin as settled.
